entries.title: Exodus 18:1
segments: ¶And Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel His people-that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 18:2
segments: Then Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

entries.title: Exodus 18:3
segments: with her two sons, of whom the name of one [was] Gershom (for he said, "I have been a stranger in a foreign land")

entries.title: Exodus 18:4
segments: and the name of the other [was] Eliezer (for [he said], "The God of my father [was] my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh");

entries.title: Exodus 18:5
segments: and Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.

entries.title: Exodus 18:6
segments: Now he had said to Moses, "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons with her."

entries.title: Exodus 18:7
segments: ¶So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, bowed down, and kissed him. And they asked each other about [their] well-being, and they went into the tent.

entries.title: Exodus 18:8
segments: And Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, all the hardship that had come upon them on the way, and [how] the LORD had delivered them.

entries.title: Exodus 18:9
segments: Then Jethro rejoiced for all the good which the LORD had done for Israel, whom He had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 18:10
segments: And Jethro said, "Blessed [be] the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharaoh, [and] who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 18:11
segments: "Now I know that the LORD [is] greater than all the gods; for in the very thing in which they behaved proudly, [He was] above them."

entries.title: Exodus 18:12
segments: Then Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took a burnt offering and [other] sacrifices [to offer] to God. And Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God.

entries.title: Exodus 18:13
segments: ¶And so it was, on the next day, that Moses sat to judge the people; and the people stood before Moses from morning until evening.

entries.title: Exodus 18:14
segments: So when Moses' father-in-law saw all that he did for the people, he said, "What [is] this thing that you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit, and all the people stand before you from morning until evening?"

entries.title: Exodus 18:15
segments: And Moses said to his father-in-law, "Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

entries.title: Exodus 18:16
segments: "When they have a difficulty, they come to me, and I judge between one and another; and I make known the statutes of God and His laws."

entries.title: Exodus 18:17
segments: So Moses' father-in-law said to him, "The thing that you do [is] not good.

entries.title: Exodus 18:18
segments: "Both you and these people who [are] with you will surely wear yourselves out. For this thing [is] too much for you; you are not able to perform it by yourself.

entries.title: Exodus 18:19
segments: "Listen now to my voice; I will give you counsel, and God will be with you: Stand before God for the people, so that you may bring the difficulties to God.

entries.title: Exodus 18:20
segments: "And you shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and show them the way in which they must walk and the work they must do.

entries.title: Exodus 18:21
segments: "Moreover you shall select from all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place [such] over them [to be] rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

entries.title: Exodus 18:22
segments: "And let them judge the people at all times. Then it will be [that] every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they themselves shall judge. So it will be easier for you, for they will bear [the burden] with you.

entries.title: Exodus 18:23
segments: "If you do this thing, and God [so] commands you, then you will be able to endure, and all this people will also go to their place in peace."

entries.title: Exodus 18:24
segments: So Moses heeded the voice of his father-in-law and did all that he had said.

entries.title: Exodus 18:25
segments: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people: rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

entries.title: Exodus 18:26
segments: So they judged the people at all times; the hard cases they brought to Moses, but they judged every small case themselves.

entries.title: Exodus 18:27
segments: Then Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way to his own land.
